settings.label: 1 if len(answers['text']) > 0 else 0
settings.overlap_policy: Remove all raw train rows whose group occurs anywhere in raw validation.
settings.group_split: Sort remaining groups lexicographically; shuffle using random.Random(42). Take the first max(1, min(n-1, int(n*0.1+0.5))) groups for validation; all others for train. Preserve original row order within each split.
settings.test_sampling: Use a separate random.Random(42). Sample 500 indices without replacement from label=1, then 500 from label=0, in raw validation row order; shuffle the combined indices using that same test RNG.
settings.manifest_checksum: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON ID array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'); no newline
